answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock a $10,000 bond in escrow. Second, the secure hardware kernel generates a unique cryptographic signature from the enclave. Third, the network validates this crystal-clear proof of identity via the TPM. Finally, the agent collects nectar rewards for valid tasks. An attacker would need $1,000,000 in bonds and 48 hours of compute per fake identity to succeed. This mechanism acts like a deep, ancient well where only the most precious, heavy gold can reach the bottom.
